findings.description: The release-launch check fails for 3 of 5 runtimes. The server commands of campaign22 (easy), campaign23 (hard) and campaign24 (chaos) carry '-Dachievetodo.progression.freshConfig=true' in addition to the two -javaagent args, and the brief requires no -Dachievetodo.* flags. Only campaign21 and campaign25 match the certified operator launch, so every thresholds-easy/hard/chaos row of this group comes from a launch composition that is not the certified one. The ReleaseLaunchProfile javadoc says freshConfig is derived only on the start that writes the world group; here it was passed by hand, and the logged derived=[...] list does not include it.
